title: Senior business/system analyst (disaster recovery)
description:
Product Overview:
Vuori is re-defining what athletic apparel looks like: built to move and sweat in but designed with a casual aesthetic to transition into everyday life. Our high-energy, fast-paced office environment is reflected in the clothes we make. We aim to inspire others to take on all aspects of their lives with clarity, enthusiasm, and purpose…. while having a lot of fun along the way. We are proud to be an outlet for the opportunity of personal growth and success.Overview
We are seeking a contract Business Analyst to support the development and execution of our Disaster Recovery (DR) Program. This role will help establish structure, documentation, and repeatable processes to ensure our DR efforts are organized, testable, and aligned with business needs.Key Responsibilities
Develop the overall structure and framework for the Disaster Recovery Program, including roles, responsibilities, and governance.
Create and refine documentation such as DR runbooks, process flows, and system recovery procedures.
Partner with technical teams to capture system dependencies, failover steps, testing requirements, and validation criteria.
Build templates, standards, and repeatable processes to drive consistency across DR documentation.
Coordinate project tasks, track progress, and support cross-functional alignment to ensure milestones are met.
Facilitate workshops and gather requirements from subject-matter experts.
Define DR test planning, evidence capture, post-test reviews, and continuous improvement activities.
Ensure documentation aligns with internal standards and compliance requirements (e.g., SOX, SOC2).Required Qualifications
5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Program Coordinator, or similar role.
Experience supporting Disaster Recovery, Business Continuity, or technology resilience programs.
Strong communication and documentation skills with the ability to translate complex technical inputs into clear, structured outputs.
Ability to collaborate effectively with infrastructure, applications, and security teams.
Proficiency with tools such as Confluence, Jira, Microsoft 365, and diagramming solutions.
Advanced spoken English level (B2–C1 or higher).Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Azure, Saa S vendor DR models, or hybrid cloud environments.
Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOX, SOC2, or ISO 22301.
Prior involvement in DR tabletop exercisesWe offer:
We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), and a flexible work schedule.
Personal laptop.
Health/Sport Budget.
Fully remote.

title: Assembly and after-sales support technician
description:
Job Description
Job Title:Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician
Location:Remote position in Brazil with in-person client visits as required
Reports to:Account Manager and CTO
Contract Type:CLTAbout LG Sonic: LG Sonicis a global leader in sustainable water quality management, dedicated to developing cutting-edge technologies that help protect water ecosystems. With operations in over 50 countries, we specialize in advanced solutions for algae control, water quality monitoring, and environmental protection. Our award-winning ultrasonic technology, combined with real-time data monitoring, empowers industries, municipalities, and governments to maintain clean and healthy water bodies while reducing chemical use. At LG Sonic, we foster a dynamic and innovative work environment, driven by a passion for sustainability and technological excellence. Join our team and be part of a mission to create cleaner water for future generations.Position Summary:
The Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician will be responsible for assembling, installing, and maintaining LG Sonic equipment at our clients' sites across various locations in Brazil. In addition to on-site technical duties, the professional will work remotely in an after-sales capacity, providing direct support and maintaining close communication with clients to ensure their needs are met effectively.
Position duties and responsibilities:
Assemble and install LG Sonic equipment at client locations throughout Brazil, ensuring proper setup and functionality.
Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs on installed equipment to guarantee optimal performance.
Travel to client sites as needed to address technical issues and provide on-site support.
Provide remote after-sales support, responding to client inquiries, offering technical guidance, and resolving issues via phone, email, or other communication platforms.
Maintain direct and proactive communication with clients to ensure satisfaction and address their needs effectively.
Document all assembly, maintenance, and support activities, preparing detailed reports for internal records and client follow-ups.
Collaborate with the LG Sonic team to identify opportunities for equipment improvements or upgrades based on client feedback and field observations.
Adhere to safety protocols and company standards during all on-site and remote activities.Qualification and requirements:
Must reside in Brazil and be willing to travel frequently to client sites across the country with flexibility to adapt to varying schedules.
Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English (written and spoken)for client interactions, technical support, and reporting.
Proven experience in equipment assembly, installation, and maintenance, preferably in a technical or industrial setting.
Strong problem-solving skills
Ability to work independently in the field and remotely, with strong organizational and time-management skills.
Familiarity with remote support tools and basic computer skills for documentation and communication.
Valid driver’s license and ability to operate safely in diverse working environments.
Previous experience in after-sales or customer support roles is a plus.Why Join LG Sonic?At LG Sonic, we offer an exciting and collaborative work environment where your contributions directly impact our mission of environmental sustainability and innovation. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to grow professionally while being a part of a global leader in water treatment technology. We believe in investing in our people and fostering an inclusive culture where every team member’s ideas are valued.LG Sonic Values : Unity, Trust, Positivism, Over deliver and Passion.Application Process:If you are interested in joining LG Sonic, we encourage you to apply by following these steps:
Submit Your CV: Please send yourupdated CV in Englishtowith the subject line:Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician.
Apply via Recruitment Platforms: You may also apply through recruitment websites where this position is posted. Please ensure yourCV is submitted in English.
Application Review: Our HR team will carefully review all applications and contact shortlisted candidates for the next steps.
Interview Process:Selected candidates will be invited for interviews to assess their skills, experience, and suitability for the role.

Advanced expertise in SQL, including complex query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and stored procedure development. Deep understanding of how CPU, memory, storage, and I/O constraints impact database and data architecture performance. Experience defining and applying architectural best practices for high availability, scalability, and performance. Strong proficiency using GitHub for version control, collaboration, and documentation. Ability to work independently, take ownership of architectural decisions, and drive improvements end to end. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data quality and system performance. Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with distributed and US-based teams.You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities: Design, evolve, and maintain data architectures that prioritize performance, scalability, and reliability on AWS RDS and Aurora. Collaborate closely with software engineers and technical teams to ensure strong alignment between application and data layers. Establish and promote best practices for database performance monitoring, optimization, and reliability across environments. Review and optimize stored procedures and complex SQL logic from an architectural and performance perspective. Document data architecture decisions, performance guidelines, and optimization strategies. Act as a technical reference and advisor for data architecture and performance topics across teams. Support technical discussions with stakeholders by providing clear recommendations and trade-off analyses.Additional Information About UsWe Are Engineered Different.At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values:Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

title: Analista De Validação De Processo
description:
1. Planejar, coordenar e executar estudos de validação de processos de fabricação. Elaborar protocolos, relatórios e análises críticas para suportar a reprodutibilidade e consistência do processo.

2. Desenvolver e executar protocolos de validação de limpeza para assegurar a remoção eficaz de resíduos e evitar a contaminação cruzada. Determinar os limites de aceitação de acordo com os requisitos de boas práticas de fabricação (GMP).

3. Planejar e conduzir validações de filtração esterilizante, incluindo testes de integridade, adsorção e retenção bacteriana para garantir a eficácia dos filtros utilizados nos processos de esterilização.

4. Realizar estudos de tempo de espera (holding time) para determinar e validar os tempos máximos permitidos entre as etapas críticas de produção, garantindo a manutenção da qualidade e esterilidade dos produtos.

5. Elaborar, revisar e aprovar protocolos, relatórios de validação de envase asséptico e outros documentos técnicos. Garantir a integridade e a rastreabilidade de todos os registros, em conformidade com as exigências regulamentares e padrões internos.

6. Atuar como referência técnica em processos de validação durante auditorias internas e externas, incluindo inspeções de autoridades sanitárias e auditorias de clientes.

7. Participação ativa em investigações de desvios, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas;

8. Elaborar apresentações e treinamentos referentes às atividades sob sua responsabilidade.

9. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes de qualidade, produção, engenharia e desenvolvimento, para a implementação de melhorias contínuas nos processos validados e o suporte técnico necessário em projetos e mudanças.

10. Participação da elaboração de URS (User Requirements Specification) para definição de novos projetos ou alteração de projetos já existentes.

title: Nurse Offshore
description:
Position: Nurse Offshore

Location: FPSO Marechal Duque de Caxias


About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.


Job Purpose

The Offshore Nurse is responsible for leading onboard health services, ensuring hospital readiness, providing medical assistance, and promoting a healthy working environment and overall wellbeing for all personnel onboard the FPSO. The role also ensures compliance with corporate health standards and applicable regulations.


Key Responsibilities

Lead onboard health services, ensuring hospital readiness and proper medical assistance at all times;

Activate MEDEVAC procedures in accordance with remote medical support instructions;

Maintain updated inventory of medicines and medical supplies, ensuring availability and preventing expired items onboard;

Liaise with onshore remote medical support for diagnosis guidance and prescription of medicines for injured or ill personnel;

Support the preparation and implementation of rescue plans (confined space and working at height);

Request calibration, hydrostatic testing, and replacement of hospital equipment and first aid kits to ensure prompt emergency response;

Inspect catering services and facilities, including food storage, conservation, preparation, and accommodation cleanliness, maintaining proper health inspection records;

Participate in auditing and certification processes related to health services;

Collect and monitor fresh and potable water samples, conducting analysis onboard and coordinating onshore testing in accordance with procedures;

Provide First Aidtraining to designated first aid teams onboard;

Prepare and maintain medical documentation and reports (Health Initial Report, Logbook, corporate reports, and other required documents);

Implement and maintain the Health Service Waste Management Program and ensure proper recordkeeping.


Requirements

Degree in Nursing with valid COREN registration;

Previous experience in offshore operations (FPSO or oil & gas environment preferred);

Advanced life support and emergency care training;

Experience with occupational health routines and health surveillance;

Fluent English (minimum intermediate level);

Strong organizational skills and ability to work independently onboard;

Knowledge of Brazilian maritime and health regulations is an advantage.


Benefits

Meal and food allowances

Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay)

Life Insurance

Annual Bonus

Private Pension Plan

Childcare Allowance


Note

This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.

title: Master Data Modeler
description:
Position Summary and Location

Support the design, development, and maintenance of master data models that ensure the accuracy and consistency of key business data across systems. Collaborate with senior team members to model data structures and optimize data flow, supporting various departments such as finance, sales, and operations. This position is ideal for someone with a passion for data modeling, a keen eye for detail, and a desire to grow in data management and governance.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Assist in the design and development of master data models for master domains such as customer, assets, supplier, and financial data.
  • Help create and maintain data models (conceptual, logical, and physical) that align with business needs and data governance policies.
  • Ensure the accuracy and integrity of master data by supporting data modeling standards and best practices.
  • Analyze data from various sources to support data modeling decisions and validate the accuracy and completeness of master data.
  • Perform basic data profiling and quality checks to identify patterns, anomalies, and potential improvements in data structures.
  • Collaborate with data quality and data governance teams to ensure consistency across systems.
  • Assist in designing data flow diagrams and documenting data mappings between different systems.
  • Work with data engineers and system architects to integrate master data models with existing databases and applications.
  • Support the creation of data management workflows that optimize data retrieval, storage, and reporting processes.
  • Help maintain documentation for master data models, including data definitions, relationships, and lineage.
  • Prepare reports and presentations on data modeling findings and recommendations to stakeholders and team members.
  • Contribute to the development of metadata repositories and data dictionaries to support enterprise data governance.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in data management, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Relevant coursework or project experience in data modeling, databases, or data management is a plus.
  • Basic understanding of data modeling concepts (e.G., entity-relationship models, dimensional modeling) and database structures.
  • Familiarity with data modeling tools such as Erwin, IBM InfoSphere Data Architect, SAP PowerDesigner, or similar tools.
  • Proficiency in SQL for querying databases and understanding relational data structures.
  • Some exposure to data governance principles, master data management (MDM), and data integration processes.


Desired Qualifications

  • Hands-on project experience in data modeling, data management, or database design.
  • Experience working with relational database management systems (RDBMS) such as Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL.
  • Familiarity with metadata management and data dictionary tools is a plus.


Location: This position can be located in Rio de Janeiro, Niterói or Macaé.


This opportunity covers disabled or rehabilitated people.

title: Senior Azure Cloud Architect
description:
About You

You are a senior-level Azure Cloud Architect who enjoys building secure, scalable, and automated cloud platforms. You take ownership of architectural decisions and are comfortable translating business and platform requirements into repeatable Azure foundations. You value clean design, governance, and automation, and you collaborate closely with application, DevOps, security, and infrastructure teams.


You thrive in complex enterprise environments, communicate technical concepts clearly, and act as a technical reference for Azure architecture, networking, security, and platform automation.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience architecting and operating solutions in Microsoft Azure.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Proven experience implementing Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and Azure Landing Zones.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with Terraform, including modular design and remote state management.
  • Experience designing enterprise Azure architectures, including multi-subscription environments.
  • Strong experience with Azure DevOps, including YAML pipelines and CI/CD governance.
  • Solid experience designing hub-and-spoke network architectures and hybrid connectivity.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Strong understanding of cloud security, governance, and enterprise-scale architecture.
  • Experience implementing Azure security controls, RBAC, policies, and compliance standards.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and clear technical communication.
  • Azure certifications (AZ-305, AZ-400, AZ-104, AZ-204) and/or Terraform certification (nice to have).
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement Azure tenant architectures aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework and Azure Landing Zone best practices.
  • Define and manage management group hierarchies, subscription strategies, and environment separation.
  • Establish standardized patterns for identity, networking, security, governance, and logging.
  • Build and maintain Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code and integrate it into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Design and maintain multi-stage Azure DevOps pipelines for infrastructure and platform automation.
  • Architect and support enterprise networking, including hub-and-spoke topologies and hybrid connectivity.
  • Support containerized platforms using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Implement and enforce Azure security, governance, and compliance controls.
  • Collaborate with application, DevOps, security, and infrastructure teams on platform adoption.
  • Provide technical guidance and architectural direction to engineering teams.
  • Continuously improve platform reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience designing and operating Azure cloud architectures
  • Proven experience implementing Azure Landing Zones and Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF)
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)
  • Experience with Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines (YAML)
  • Advanced English proficiency.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Especialista De Planejamento Tributário
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

  • Estruturação denovas atividades, serviços e novos empreendimentos multiuso, incluindo pesquisa da legislação;

  • Atuação em projetos de M&A, com foco em reestruturações societárias preparatórias para aquisições e vendas de ativos;
  • Identificação de oportunidades e condução da implementação de projetos, a fim de garantir a maximização dos resultados e a redução de riscos fiscais.

Garantir a integridade operacional e regulatória da empresa por meio do desenvolvimento, monitoramento e aprimoramento contínuo dos controles internos, promovendo a mitigação de riscos e a conformidade com normas internas e externas.

7. Colaborar com TI para integrar controles internos aos sistemas corporativos, promovendo abordagem sistêmica.

8. Avaliar eficiência e eficácia dos processos de negócio, propondo melhorias para otimização e redução de riscos.

title: Latam-Focused Research Intern
description:
About BCP Securities Group

Founded in 1989, BCP Securities, Inc. is an American brokerage and investment bank focused on fixed income in emerging markets. Headquartered in Greenwich, Connecticut, with offices in strategic cities such as Rio de Janeiro, Miami, Los Angeles, Madrid, Mexico City, and Singapore, BCP is a global reference in customized financial solutions. Recognized for its excellence and ethical commitment, the company offers innovative and effective services to meet the needs of clients around the world.

Workplace: Rio de Janeiro, 100% on-site Contract Type: Internship

Position Description

We are looking for a motivated and curious Research Intern to join our Research team, with a focus on Latin America’s, particularly Argentina’s, macroeconomic and financial environment . This position is ideal for students who are eager to learn and develop their skills in economic and financial research.

The selected candidate must be native or fluent in Spanish and English (mandatory) and will support the research team in conducting studies, preparing financial reports, and assisting senior analysts in day-to-day activities.


Please note: Resumes will only be accepted if written English. Applications submitted in Portuguese will not be considered .

Main Responsibilities

· Support the preparation of financial reports on companies and the monitoring of key economic and financial indicators.

· Assist in preparing summaries and basic analyses of market trends, economic projections, and corporate earnings.

· Help monitor economic events, public policy changes, and macroeconomic data that may impact financial markets.

· Track the performance and movements of financial assets.

· Assist in the development of financial models for company valuation, under the guidance of senior analysts.

· Support data collection, organization, and basic analysis.

· Assist with administrative and operational tasks such as organizing meetings, reports, and presentation materials.

· Collaborate in the preparation of materials for internal use and for investor or market communications.

Requirements

· Fluent Spanish and fluent English (mandatory).

· Currently pursuing a degree in Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Accounting, or related fields.

· Basic understanding of financial concepts such as financial statements, company valuation, and financial instruments.

· Ability to read and interpret financial statements and corporate reports.

· Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with attention to detail.

· Good Excel skills (formulas, basic financial modeling).

· Clear and structured written communication skills.

· Willingness to learn, curiosity about financial markets, and interest in economic trends and global events.

Differentials

· Previous internship or academic experience in finance, economics, or capital markets.

· Familiarity with financial information platforms such as Bloomberg or Reuters.

· Knowledge of basic programming or data analysis tools (e.G., Python, VBA, Power BI).

Benefits

· Hands-on learning experience in a global company with a strong presence in the fixed income market.

· Exposure to macroeconomic analysis, company research, and financial markets in LatAm.

· Continuous learning, mentoring, and professional development.

· Collaborative, dynamic, and supportive work environment.

title: Service Engineer
description:
Job Summary:

The Service Engineer will be responsible for meeting the daily maintenance and repair needs of customer equipment. They must establish and maintain appropriate business relationships with customers and colleagues, as well as perform necessary administrative activities and other assigned functions.


In this role, your responsibilities will be:

Onboard Service Execution:

  • Provide support, supervise, and test/troubleshoot field issues onboard vessels and various offshore units. This includes sailing/staying onboard vessels/units while handling services and warranty-related matters.
  • Execute the requested service in the best possible way to meet customer deadlines and expectations.

Commissioning and On-site Sea Trial Execution:

  • Test, calibrate, and verify the system configuration within Emerson ICMS software and other ICMS supplies and Emerson marine products.
  • Deliver and obtain approvals from the Shipyard, Owner, and Class during sea trials.

Reports / Administrative Activities:

  • Clearly written work reports must be completed upon returning from trips, in English, detailing all follow-up points.
  • Onboard service reports must be signed by customers.
  • Stay up to date on administrative responsibilities such as maintaining internal service reports and internal records in a timely manner.

Participation in FAT Tests:

  • Participate in customer equipment workshop tests, together with project engineering, the end customer, and Class.

Training:

  • Participate in all trainings and meetings as required by Emerson.
  • Participate in, observe, and comply with the company’s health and safety guidelines and contribute to a safe work environment.
  • Attend local trainings in the workshop/laboratory/classroom in Denmark and other locations as needed to obtain product updates.
  • Provide basic on-site/onboard training for customers/crews.


Who You Are:

You use customer insights to guide and direct the development of new offerings. You go beyond the obvious and do not stop at the first answers. You anticipate conflicts before they happen, based on your understanding of interpersonal and group dynamics. You act quickly and decisively in unpredictable and fast-changing situations. You take consistent action to develop new skills.


For this role, you will need:

  • Electrical/Mechanical education with strong knowledge of software and hardware. Additional certifications or training in maintenance, repair, or technical fields related to marine equipment are a plus.
  • 3 years of experience in a similar role, with hands-on troubleshooting, repair, and maintenance of complex technical equipment or systems. Ability to work in a global environment.
  • Experience dealing with customers in high-pressure environments.
  • Availability to work overtime, as needed.
  • Computer literacy and experience with MS Office and Excel.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese, written and spoken.
  • Work location: Rio de Janeiro.


Our Culture and Commitment to You:

At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where all employees are valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We promote an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives, because we know great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to continuous career development and fostering an inclusive culture ensures that you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe that diverse teams, working together, are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

We recognize the importance of employee well-being. We offer medical, dental, pharmacy, and Wellhub (Gympass) benefits;
life insurance;
credit union;
private pension plan;
recognition programs, and much more. Our people-focused culture includes resource groups and an employee assistance program, as well as extended parental leave (both maternal and paternal) as part of our Empresa Cidadã certification.

title: Coordenador De Segurança Da Informação E Infraestrutura De Ti
description:
Estamos em busca de um Coordenador de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura de TI que será responsável por coordenar as atividades de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura de TI, garantindo a proteção dos ativos digitais e o funcionamento estável e seguro dos ambientes corporativos e críticos da empresa de energia. Atuar como elo entre a estratégia definida pela Superintendência e a execução pelas equipes técnicas, assegurando conformidade regulatória, resiliência operacional e alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.


Seus desafios serão:


  • Liderar a equipe de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura, promovendo integração entre processos, pessoas e tecnologia.
  • Implementar e manter políticas, normas e controles de segurança alinhados a frameworks como ISO 27001, NIST CSF, IEC 62443, LGPD e regulamentos setoriais (ANEEL, ONS).
  • Coordenar atividades de gestão de vulnerabilidades, hardening, monitoração e resposta a incidentes (TI e OT).
  • Apoiar a operação do SNOC (Security & Network Operations Center) e a interface com o CSIRT, garantindo tempos de resposta adequados a incidentes.
  • Supervisionar a gestão de identidades e acessos (IAM), controles de rede, servidores e sistemas críticos.
  • Apoiar o planejamento e a execução de projetos de infraestrutura de TI, assegurando que os requisitos de segurança estejam integrados desde o desenho.
  • Garantir continuidade operacional e planos de recuperação de desastres (BCP/DRP).
  • Promover campanhas de conscientização em segurança e boas práticas para colaboradores e fornecedores.
  • Interagir com áreas regulatórias, auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo evidências de conformidade.
  • Reportar periodicamente à Superintendência o status da segurança, principais riscos e indicadores de desempenho.


O que é necessário você ter:


  • Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia, Segurança da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Segurança da Informação (obrigatório).
  • Certificações valorizadas: CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, CompTIA Security+, ITIL, Azure/AWS Security, ou IEC 62443.
  • Experiência comprovada em:
  • Segurança da Informação: gestão de vulnerabilidades, SNOC, IAM, políticas, auditorias.
  • Infraestrutura de TI: administração de servidores (Windows/Linux), redes, storage, gestão de ambientes críticos.
  • Resiliência Operacional: continuidade de negócios, backup, DRP.
  • Vivência em empresas de energia ou setores críticos será diferencial.
  • Conhecimento em Inteligência Artificial aplicada à Segurança da Informação (uso de IA para detecção de ameaças, análise comportamental e automação de resposta a incidentes).

title: Hr Training Analyst
description:
Position: HR Training Analyst

Location: Barra da Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro


About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.


Job Purpose

The HR Training & Personnel Logistics Analyst is responsible for ensuring full compliance of offshore personnel with mandatory training requirements, managing training logistics, and maintaining accurate certification records in DRAKE System.

The role also supports HR strategy implementation, training governance, personnel logistics coordination, and operational workforce readiness in alignment with corporate policies and project needs.


Key Responsibilities

Ensure that all offshore personnel hold valid mandatory training and certifications required for offshore deployment;

Coordinate all logistics arrangements for trainings scheduled in the DRAKE System;

Maintain strict control and timely updates of training and certification records in DRAKE;

Provide HR expertise in developing and implementing training-related policies, processes, and improvement actions according to business needs;

Interpret, apply,and uphold corporate policies and legal requirements with strong customer focus and best practices;

Apply an integrated approach when managing the employee mandatory training cycle (training matrix, gap analysis, deviation notices, certifications, training providers, and budget control) to effectively support Projects and Operations;

Monitor and support the local execution of HR Training policies, procedures, and processes;

Assist in managing the training budget, including creation and follow-up of Purchase Requisitions (PRs) for all training-related expenses;

Coordinate feedback from personnel regarding training provider performance and recommend improvements to management;

Support audits and evaluations of training service providers;

Provide operational support to the Personnel Logistics team, including weekend on-call coverage and emergency demands when required;

Control operational activities related to personnel departure, mobilization, and allocation.


Requirements

Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field;

Previous experience in offshore operations, oil & gas, or maritime environment preferred;

Experience managing training matrices and certification control systems (DRAKE knowledge is an advantage);

Knowledge of Brazilian labor and maritime regulations is desirable;

Fluent English (minimum intermediate level);

Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities;

Proactive profilewith strong interface capability between HR and Operations.


Benefits

Meal and food allowances;

Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, no co-pay);

Life Insurance;

Annual Bonus;

Private Pension Plan;

Childcare Allowance.


Note

This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.

Buscamos profissionais com perfil consultivo, visão de negócio e alta capacidade relacional, que tenham:


  • Experiência prévia em vendas B2B complexas ou consultivas;
  • Capacidade de atuar com múltiplos stakeholders e influenciar decisores;

  • Boa comunicação, presença executiva e habilidade de negociação;
  • Graduação completa;
  • Inglês avançado.


Nosso compromisso com a diversidade


Na Robert Half, acreditamos que diversidade de experiências, perspectivas e histórias fortalece nossos resultados. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, respeitoso e equitativo, onde cada pessoa pode ser quem é e atingir seu máximo potencial.

Se você busca uma posição comercial estratégica, com impacto real nos negócios dos clientes e na carreira das pessoas, venha construir o futuro com a Robert Half.

Qualidade Por que isso importa

Este trabalho não é para todos. Você ouvirá "não" muito mais do que ouvirá "sim". Você fará ligações mesmo quando não estiver com vontade. Você passará por cima da rejeição e continuará em frente.

Não queremos currículos. Queremos ver você. Grave um vídeo de 30 segundos respondendo:

  • Desejável pós-graduação em Infraestrutura de TI, Segurança da Informação ou Engenharia de Conectividade.


EXPERIÊNCIA/CONHECIMENTOS


  • Imprescindível experiência em administração e suporte de redes corporativas LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi, em ambientes on-premises e cloud;
  • Conhecimento avançado em roteamento, switching, firewalls, NAT, VLANs, QoS e VPNs;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de monitoramento e automação de rede (Zabbix, SolarWinds, PRTG, Ansible);
  • Experiência em ambientes híbridos e multicloud, com integração entre redes locais e provedores cloud;
  • Conhecimento deprotocolos de rede (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SNMP, BGP, OSPF);
  • Familiaridade com segurança de rede, criptografia, IDS/IPS, segmentação e controle de acesso;
  • Capacidade de diagnóstico e troubleshooting de incidentes complexos de conectividade;
  • Vivência em ambientes corporativos críticos e regulados, com requisitos de alta disponibilidade e compliance;
  • Familiaridade com soluções de rede e segurança Cisco, Palo Alto e Trend Micro;
  • Necessário Inglês técnico intermediário (para leitura de documentação e interface com fornecedores globais).



MISSÃO DA POSIÇÃO


Garantir a operação estável, segura e eficiente das redes de comunicação de dados e voz do IRB(Re), assegurando disponibilidade, desempenho e confiabilidade dos serviços de conectividade corporativa. É o responsável técnico pela infraestrutura de rede, abrangendo LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, firewalls e equipamentos de comunicação, suportando as operações do negócio e garantindo conformidade com as políticas de segurança e governança de TI.

Assegurar a continuidade e a resiliência das redes corporativas, promovendo padronização, automação e melhoria contínua da infraestrutura de conectividade que sustenta os sistemas críticos e o ambiente híbrido do IRB(Re).


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES


Gestão e Operação de Ambientes

  • Administrar e monitorar a rede corporativa LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi, em ambientes on-premises e cloud, garantindo disponibilidade, estabilidade e desempenho;
  • Configurar, manter e otimizar switches, roteadores, access points, firewalls, balanceadores e VPNs;
  • Monitorar a latência, throughput e integridade dos enlaces de rede, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas;
  • Executar rotinas de backup e restauração de configurações de rede;
  • Gerenciar e documentar o inventário de equipamentos de rede, seus contratos de manutenção;
  • Apoiar times deService Desk e Infraestrutura na resolução de incidentes relacionados à conectividade;
  • Garantir o cumprimento de SLAs de disponibilidade e performance de rede, com reportes regulares à Governança de TI.


Implementação e Melhoria Contínua

  • Planejar e executar projetos de implantação, atualização e expansão de rede, em alinhamento com Engenharia & Plataforma;
  • Definição de escopo técnico para projetos de infraestrutura de redes, visando escalabilidade e alta disponibilidade dos serviços, garantindo o alinhamento entre requisitos técnicos e necessidades de negócio;
  • Avaliar novas tecnologias e padrões de conectividade (SD-WAN, Wi-Fi 6, 5G, Zero Trust Network Access);
  • Automatizar tarefas de configuração e monitoração com uso de ferramentas de gerenciamento de rede e scripts (Ansible, Python, SNMP, etc.);
  • Apoiar a integração de ambientes on-premises e cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP) garantindo conectividade segura;
  • Participar da definição de arquiteturas de rede resilientes e escaláveis, em conjunto com Arquitetura Corporativa;
  • Documentar diagramas, topologias e fluxos de rede no repositório corporativo de arquitetura;
  • Realizar testesde carga, failover e redundância em enlaces críticos.


Segurança, Governança e Compliance

  • Operar e gerenciar ferramentas de segurança, como: Endpoint Security, NGFW, PAM, WAF, Cloud Email Security, NAC, DNS Security, de acordo as diretrizes do CISO;
  • Monitorar e responder a alertas de segurança de rede, incidentes e vulnerabilidades, em colaboração com o time de Cyber Service;
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo evidências de controles e conformidade (LGPD, SUSEP, SOX);
  • Assegurar a execução de atualizações de firmware e patches de segurança nos dispositivos de rede;
  • Gerenciar logs e trilhas de auditoria de equipamentos e soluções de rede;
  • Apoiar o planejamento e execução de planos de continuidade e recuperação de desastres (DRP) para infraestrutura de rede.

  • Previdência privada
  • Seguro de vida

description:
Job Description

Job Title: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician

Location: Remote position in Brazil with in-person client visits as required

Reports to: Account Manager and CTO

Contract Type: CLT


About LG Sonic: LG Sonic is a global leader in sustainable water quality management, dedicated to developing cutting-edge technologies that help protect water ecosystems. With operations in over 50 countries, we specialize in advanced solutions for algae control, water quality monitoring, and environmental protection. Our award-winning ultrasonic technology, combined with real-time data monitoring, empowers industries, municipalities, and governments to maintain clean and healthy water bodies while reducing chemical use. At LG Sonic, we foster a dynamic and innovative work environment, driven by a passion for sustainability and technological excellence. Join our team and be part of a mission to create cleaner water for future generations.


Position Summary:

The Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician will be responsible for assembling, installing, and maintaining LG Sonic equipment at our clients' sites across various locations in Brazil. In addition to on-site technical duties, the professional will work remotely in an after-sales capacity, providing direct support and maintaining close communication with clients to ensure their needs are met effectively.

Position duties and responsibilities:

  • Assemble and install LG Sonic equipment at client locations throughout Brazil, ensuring proper setup and functionality.
  • Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs on installed equipment to guarantee optimal performance.
  • Travel to client sites as needed to address technical issues and provide on-site support.
  • Provide remote after-sales support, responding to client inquiries, offering technical guidance, and resolving issues via phone, email, or other communication platforms.
  • Maintain direct and proactive communication with clients to ensure satisfaction and address their needs effectively.
  • Document all assembly, maintenance, and support activities, preparing detailed reports for internal records and client follow-ups.
  • Collaborate with the LG Sonic team to identify opportunities for equipment improvements or upgrades based on client feedback and field observations.
  • Adhere to safety protocols and company standards during all on-site and remote activities.


Qualification and requirements:

  • Must reside in Brazil and be willing to travel frequently to client sites across the country with flexibility to adapt to varying schedules.
  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English (written and spoken) for client interactions, technical support, and reporting.
  • Proven experience in equipment assembly, installation, and maintenance, preferably in a technical or industrial setting.
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently in the field and remotely, with strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Familiarity with remote support tools and basic computer skills for documentation and communication.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to operate safely in diverse working environments.
  • Previous experience in after-sales or customer support roles is a plus.


Why Join LG Sonic? At LG Sonic, we offer an exciting and collaborative work environment where your contributions directly impact our mission of environmental sustainability and innovation. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to grow professionally while being a part of a global leader in water treatment technology. We believe in investing in our people and fostering an inclusive culture where every team member’s ideas are valued.


LG Sonic Values : Unity, Trust, Positivism, Over deliver and Passion.


Application Process: If you are interested in joining LG Sonic, we encourage you to apply by following these steps:

  • Submit Your CV: Please send your updated CV in English to with the subject line: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician .
  • Apply via Recruitment Platforms: You may also apply through recruitment websites where this position is posted. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English .
  • Application Review: Our HR team will carefully review all applications and contact shortlisted candidates for the next steps.
  • Interview Process: Selected candidates will be invited for interviews to assess their skills, experience, and suitability for the role.

title: Engenheiro(A) De Serviços - Rj
description:
Resumo do cargo:

Proporciona suporte técnico qualificado à base instalada, conseguindo a satisfação do cliente através da execução dos serviços e contratos de acordo com o escopo e orçamento definido.


Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:

1) Assessoramento na elaboração e no cumprimento de programas de manutenção corretiva, preventiva e preditiva, além de assessoria técnica nas intervenções nos sistemas Emerson Machine Automation Solutions (antiga GE Automation & Controls);

2) Levantamento de dados, elaboração de fluxogramas, diagramas, memórias de cálculo e de estudos, visando a seleção do equipamento, material, execução de um projeto ou a adoção da solução mais econômica para resolução de problemas em instalações industriais de automação, existentes;

3) Elaboração de projetos básicos contendo Procedimentos Técnicos, Memoriais Descritivos de Construção e Montagem e de Memoriais Descritivos para Contratação de Projetos Executivos, obedecendo aos padrões da PETROBRAS;

4) Análise de projetos e estudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson;

5) Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.E. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);

6) Gerenciamento,monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson);

7) Elaboração, desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos);

8) Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, assim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;

9) Comissionamento de novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial.


Quem você é:

Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente.


Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação em Engenharia, preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica ou de Automação;
  • Ter no mínimo 6anos de experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);
  • Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
  • Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;
  • Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition e etc;
  • Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
  • Disponibilidadepara viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
  • Disponibilidadepara trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
  • Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.


Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

title: Gerente Operações (Rj)
description:
Sobre a Empresa



Dr. Consulta é uma empresa de atenção primária – líder em SP.

Estamos em busca de um profissional que será responsável por desenvolver e capacitar as lideranças dos centros médico odontológicos sob a sua gestão, garantindo eficiência e crescimento sustentável, acompanhando os indicadores e gerenciando/criando projetos junto às áreas de negócio e implementando ações para melhoria contínua da operação.



Responsabilidades


  • Garantir a padronização dos processos em todos os centros médico odontológicos sob sua gerência (Admissão, pré-consulta, consulta médica, realização de exames, pós consulta) pautado nos procedimentos operacionais padrão (POPs) da companhia.
  • Gerenciar indicadores que refletem os processos implantados, garantindo o resultado operacional uniforme em suas unidades, desenvolvendo planos de ações junto os coordenadores locais para melhoria dos desvios;
    (TMA, TME, % atraso na recepção, % atraso na enfermagem, NPS, Tx passagem nos pós consulta, pré venda, % da venda de cartões DRC).
  • Apoiar os coordenadores locais com a solução de problemas relacionados com a estrutura física e de serviços terceiros prestados dentro dos centros médico odontológicos, gerenciando 100% dos chamados abertos por seus liderados de forma a garantir o atendimento dentro dos SLAs estabelecidos e o correto funcionamento das unidades.
  • Gerenciar a equipe de coordenadores e suas atividades como líderes diretos das equipes de suas unidades (atendimento, enfermagem, tecnólogos, assistentes de sala e médicos), realizando, quando necessário, feedbacks orientativos assim como reuniões semanais e/ou mensais de seus resultados.
  • Estabelecer junto com a área de treinamentos programas voltados para as lideranças operacionais nos pontos onde observar fragilidades ou oportunidades de melhoria nos processos implantados, assim como identificar potenciais lideranças para os centros médico odontológicos.
  • Gerenciar as despesas e custos dos centros médico odontológicos sob sua gerência, buscando eficiência na unidade de negócio, utilizando de sua experiência administrativa para apoiar a liderança local na organização e gerenciamento de suas despesas.
  • Realizar a interface com demais áreas da empresa contribuindo com a construção das estratégias e com seus desdobramentos para operações.
  • Reportar o Gerente de Operações, imediatamente, situações de grande risco assistencial, jurídico ou reputacional para a companhia.


Qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo;
  • Experiência sólida em gestão de operações, preferencialmente em ambientes de saúde (centros médicos, odontológicos, clínicas ou hospitais);
  • Experiência comindicadores.


Habilidades Necessárias

Trabalho 100% presencial no RJ.


Oferecemos um pacote de benefícios completo para cuidar de você:



  • Assistência Médica oferecida conforme a sua elegibilidade;
  • Vale Refeição eVale Alimentação para suas refeições diárias;
  • TotalPass para cuidar do seu bem-estar físico;
  • Vale Transportepara facilitar seu deslocamento;
  • Auxílio Creche,conforme CLT, para apoio na educação infantil;
  • Cartão Dr. Consulta com vantagens exclusivas em saúde.

title: Aws Devops Engineer
description:
About You

You are a hands-on DevOps or Infrastructure Engineer who enjoys taking ownership of Infrastructure as Code and building reliable, cloud-native environments on AWS. You are comfortable working with Terraform, provisioning container-based infrastructure, and ensuring platform stability through proper monitoring and observability.


You bring a proactive mindset, enjoy questioning technical decisions, and collaborate closely with distributed teams to continuously improve infrastructure reliability, security, and scalability.


  • This position is offered under a contractor model for an initial period of 6 months , with the possibility of extension.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps or Infrastructure Engineering roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Terraform Cloud , including writing modules and managing provisioning workflows.
  • Proven experience provisioning and managing AWS infrastructure , primarily ECS and related container services.
  • Deep understanding of Docker and container-based architectures.
  • Experience implementing monitoring and observability using CloudWatch and Datadog.
  • Familiarity with compliance practices and security-driven infrastructure changes.
  • Strong English communication skills to collaborate with distributed teams and US-based stakeholders.
  • Proactive and curious mindset, comfortable reviewing and questioning technical decisions and architectures.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Write and maintain Terraform code and modules to provision and manage AWS infrastructure using Terraform Cloud.
  • Review Terraform pull requests and provide feedback to ensure code quality and best practices.
  • Provision AWS services and work on proofs of concept (PoCs) to validate infrastructure solutions.
  • Apply infrastructure and configuration changes driven by Security and Compliance requirements.
  • Review and challenge architecture and implementation approaches to drive continuous improvement.
  • Participate in team ceremonies, including daily standups and technical discussions.
  • Collaborate closely with other engineers to ensure infrastructure reliability, scalability, and maintainability.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience with Terraform and Terraform Cloud.
  • Strong experience with AWS infrastructure (ECS and container services).
  • Experience with Docker, CloudWatch, and Datadog.
  • Conversational English (B2+).


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Remote Ai Quality Analyst (Portuguese) - 62131
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic "overnarrating".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying "Debug Info" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.G., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
Technical Account Manager – Telecom Software


Iquall es una compañía de software especializada en automatización y transformación de redes para operadores de telecomunicaciones. Trabajamos con grandes carriers, ayudándolos a modernizar su operación, automatizar procesos críticos y evolucionar la gestión de la red hacia modelos más eficientes y autónomos. Somos una empresa con fuerte ADN técnico, pero con visión comercial y foco en crecimiento sostenible. Nuestro modelo combina coherencia comercial, credibilidad técnica y ejecución sólida.


Buscamos un Technical Account Manager (TAM) con fuerte perfil estratégico y orientación al cliente para gestionar cuentas clave (Tier-1) dentro del sector telecom. El TAM es responsable de gestionar integralmente la cuenta desde lo técnico-comercial. No es un rol de soporte ni de delivery operativo. Es quien entiende los desafíos del cliente, influye en su planificación futura y construye oportunidades sostenibles. El rol combina visión técnica, desarrollo de negocio y acompañamiento post-venta para asegurar la generación de valor continuo y la adopción de nuestras soluciones de automatización.


Principales Responsabilidades

Gestión Estratégica y Desarrollo de Negocio:

  • Comprender la estructura tecnológica, operativa y presupuestaria del cliente, alineando nuestras soluciones con sus iniciativas de transformación digital y eficiencia operativa.
  • Detectar iniciativas y problemas estructurales antes de que se conviertan en procesos formales de licitación (RFPs).
  • Generar proactivamente oportunidades de upselling y cross-selling sobre la base instalada ("budget fishing").
  • Influir en la planificación futura y las líneas presupuestarias del cliente.

Venta Consultiva (Soluciones Estándar):

  • Diseñar y presentar de forma autónoma propuestas técnico-comerciales cuando la solución se base en el portafolio existente de Iquall.
  • Traducir capacidades complejas de producto en soluciones claras, viables y con sentido económico para el cliente.

Relacionamiento y Evangelización:

  • Construir vínculos sólidos y gestionar múltiples stakeholders dentro de organizaciones complejas, manteniendo credibilidad tanto frente a equipos de ingeniería/operativos como áreas ejecutivas (C-Level).
  • Orquestar workshops y sesiones ejecutivas ("Overview Demos") para mostrar el arte de lo posible e impulsar la adopción de nuevas funcionalidades.
  • Continuidad Post-Venta (Value Delivery):
  • Asegurar la correcta implementación y adopción de las soluciones vendidas.
  • Coordinar la transición hacia la ejecución junto a los Project Managers (PMs) y Delivery, identificando riesgos tempranos, pero sin gestionar la operación directamente.


Requisitos Excluyentes:

  • Experiencia: 5+ años en roles de gestión técnica de cuentas, consultoría técnica o ingeniería de ventas (Pre-Sales) con fuerte componente relacional y orientados a resultados comerciales.
  • Industria: Experiencia sólida trabajando con operadores de telecomunicaciones (Tier-1 preferentemente), conocimiento de operaciones, arquitectura de red (fija, móvi, Cloudl, ej. FTTH, 4G/5G), y plataformas OSS/BSS.
  • Formación: Título universitario en Ingeniería (Telecomunicaciones, Sistemas, Electrónica) o carrera técnica equivalente.
  • Idiomas: Dominio fluido de inglés y español.
  • Habilidades Técnicas: Conocimiento conceptual de software, modelos de despliegue (Cloud, SaaS, On-premise), APIs e integración. Familiaridad con los marcos de trabajo de la industria (ej. estándares TM Forum, eTOM, Open APIs). Entendimiento suficiente para influir técnicamente sin necesidad de ejecutar configuraciones profundas (hands-on).
  • Competencias: Comunicación técnica a nivel ejecutivo, capacidad para traducir problemas operativos en impacto de negocio, pensamiento estratégico a largo plazo y excelentes habilidades de negociación.
  • Disponibilidad: Para viajar atendiendo el territorio asignado.


Deseable

  • Experiencia previa y cartera de contactos en cuentas Tier-1 de la región.
  • Certificaciones en gestión de proyectos (PMP o similares) o Metodologías Agile.
  • Formación de posgrado en gestión tecnológica o negocios.


Qué Ofrecemos

  • Rol estratégico con impacto directo en el crecimiento de la compañía.
  • Trabajo con operadores de telecomunicaciones de primer nivel.
  • Participación en proyectos de automatización reales y de vanguardia.
  • Espacio para crecer profesionalmente combinando tecnología de alto nivel y negocio.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Brazil - Remote: Data Engineer - Platform & Pipelines
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties

We are implementing a strict Medallion Architecture to organize petabytes of industrial data. This role is for a Data Engineer who excels at transforming raw chaos into structured, queryable assets.

You will build and maintain the ELT pipelines that move data from "Bronze" (Raw) to "Silver" (Cleaned) and "Gold" (Aggregated). You will work with Delta Lake (On-prem/Databricks), Polars and Airflow to ensure data quality and availability for Data Scientists and the Knowledge Graph.

What You’ll Do

  • Pipeline Development: Develop and maintain robust Airflow DAGs to orchestrate complex data transformations.
  • Data Transformation: Use Spark (when scale requires) and Polars to clean, enrich, and aggregate data according to business logic.
  • Architecture Implementation: Enforce the Medallion Architecture patterns, ensuring clear separation of concerns between data layers.
  • Performance Tuning: Optimize processing workflows (Polars/Spark) jobs and SQL queries to reduce costs and execution time;
    make intelligent decisions on when to use Polars vs. Spark.
  • Deployment & Operations: Manage code deployment to on-prem and cloud infrastructure, including containerization and environment configuration.
  • Data Quality: Implement comprehensive data validation checks and quality gates between medallion layers.
  • Data Cataloging: Maintain the metadata and catalog entries to ensure all data assets are discoverable and documented.

The Technology Stack

  • Orchestration: Apache Airflow.
  • Data Processing: Polars (primary for ETL), PySpark/SQL (for massive scale)
  • Compute : Single-node workers (Polars), Databricks/Spark clustrers (when scale requires)
  • Storage: Delta Lake, Parquet, S3/Blob Storage, MinIO
  • Language: Python 3.12+ (w/ Polars), SQL.


Qualifications


Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering.
  • Strong proficiency in Apache Airflow and Databricks .
  • Experience implementing Medallion/Delta Lake architectures.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills.
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Experience with Unity Catalog or other governance tools.
  • Familiarity with dbt (data build tool).
  • Background in processing telemetry or sensor data.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • The Structured Thinker: You love organizing data. You understand the importance of schemas, data typing, and normalization.
  • Quality Obsessive: You don't just move data;
    you test it. You implement checks to ensure no bad data reaches the Gold layer.
  • Pipeline Builder: You view data engineering as software engineering. You write modular, reusable code for your transformations.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
About Magentrix

Magentrix is a PRM (Partner Relationship Management) SaaS platform that helps companies scale with partners. We power secure partner portals that drive adoption, collaboration, and revenue. Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services;
our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.


Role Overview

We’re hiring a Customer Success Manager based in Brazil to own a portfolio of international customers. Your focus is on outcomes such as retention, expansion, adoption, and advocacy. You’ll work with leadership to set clear goals and co-create practical plans (onboarding/time-to-value, adoption plans, save plans). You will act as a solution engineer, translating business problems and use cases into pragmatic portal solutions that deliver measurable value. You’ll have autonomy to try approaches that work for your customers and regular coaching to help you make it happen.


What You’ll Do

· Own a customer book and deliver on GRR, NRR, adoption, and NPS targets

· Co-create and run onboarding/time-to-value and adoption plans using templates, playbooks, and your ideas, iterate using data and customer feedback

· Lead EBRs, multi-thread stakeholders, and manage renewals/expansions with clear next steps

· Monitor health signals and usage, identify risks early and execute save plans

· Lead discovery to understand business use cases and pain points, design portal configurations and workflows that solve them, and clearly document and present the solution to customers

· Translate business goals into clear requirements and coordinate with Support, Product, and Services

· Capture learnings, improve playbooks, and contribute voice-of-customer insights to the roadmap


Requirements (Must-Haves)

· Fluent English (written and spoken) ;
confident facilitating executive meetings and EBRs

· 5+ years in SaaS Customer Success or adjacent roles (consulting, account management, product enablement) with measurable renewal/adoption results

· Solution engineering capability in a SaaS environment, able to run discovery, map requirements to portal capabilities, design configurations and workflows, explain trade offs, and handle live product Q&A with customers

· You’ve contributed to or improved an onboarding/TTV plan, save play, or EBR narrative

· Comfort balancing autonomy and coaching, able to propose approaches, accept feedback, and refine quickly

· Strong stakeholder management and clear written communication

· Analytical skills (spreadsheets/BI) to interpret product usage, set KPIs, and make data-backed decisions

· Familiarity with PRM/CRM concepts (partner onboarding, deal registration, content/enablement workflows)


Preferred Qualifications

· Experience with PRM, CRM, or portal products (e.G., Salesforce, HubSpot)

· Exposure to global SaaS motions (serving North America/EMEA)

· Technically self-sufficient in a SaaS environment, able to run live module demos, handle product Q&A, and perform light configuration or troubleshooting during customer calls

· Working grasp of web and SaaS fundamentals, for example HTTP and JSON basics, user roles and permissions, data mapping, environments

· Conceptual understanding of SSO standards such as SAML or OIDC

· Comfort mapping data between PRM and CRM, managing CSV imports and exports, and validating data quality during onboarding and expansion

· Ability to translate business goals into configurations or clear technical tickets and partner effectively with Support and Product


Location & Working Hours

· Brazil-based ( fully remote )

· Full overlap with Eastern Time (ET) working hours


What We Offer

· Market-aligned compensation with outcome-based variable tied to GRR/NRR

· Clear goals, regular coaching, and a path to increased scope based on results

· Autonomy within established guardrails to test approaches and iterate with data

· High visibility with leadership and direct impact on customer outcomes

· Structured feedback, documented playbooks, and opportunities to present learnings


How to Apply

Submit your CV in English , and one paragraph describing how you would approach the first 60 days after a new client’s go-live in a PRM or partner-portal context, include your assumptions, your definition of time-to-first-value, the key milestones you would drive, and how you would measure progress.

description:

São Paulo, Brazil/Buenos Aires, Argentina
